public struct KajiWebhookVerificationError: Error, Sendable, CustomStringConvertible {
    public let description: String
    fileprivate init(_ reason: String) { description = reason }

/// Standard Webhooks HMAC v1. Persist webhook-id separately for replay deduplication.
public enum StandardWebhooks {
    private static func base64(_ encoded: String) throws -> Data {
        guard encoded.range(of: #"^(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=)?$"#, options: .regularExpression) != nil,
              !encoded.contains("\n"), !encoded.contains("\r"),
              let data = Data(base64Encoded: encoded) else { throw KajiWebhookVerificationError("invalid webhook encoding") }
        return data
    }
    public static func verify(_ body: Data, headers: [String:[String]], secrets: [String], now: TimeInterval = Date().timeIntervalSince1970, tolerance: TimeInterval = 300) throws -> Data {
        guard now.isFinite, tolerance.isFinite, tolerance >= 0 else { throw KajiWebhookVerificationError("invalid webhook verification options") }
        var metadata: [String:String] = [:]
        for (name,values) in headers {
            let lower = name.lowercased()
            guard ["webhook-id","webhook-timestamp","webhook-signature"].contains(lower) else { continue }
            guard values.count == 1, metadata[lower] == nil else { throw KajiWebhookVerificationError("duplicate webhook metadata header") }
            metadata[lower] = values[0]
        }
        let id = metadata["webhook-id"] ?? "", stamp = metadata["webhook-timestamp"] ?? ""
        guard !id.isEmpty, !id.contains("."), !stamp.isEmpty, stamp.utf8.allSatisfy({ $0 >= 48 && $0 <= 57 }), let timestamp = Int64(stamp) else { throw KajiWebhookVerificationError("invalid webhook metadata") }
        guard abs(now - Double(timestamp)) <= tolerance else { throw KajiWebhookVerificationError("webhook timestamp outside tolerance") }
        var keys: [SymmetricKey] = []
        for secret in secrets {
            guard secret.hasPrefix("whsec_") else { throw KajiWebhookVerificationError("invalid webhook signing secret") }
            let key = try base64(String(secret.dropFirst(6)))
            guard (24...64).contains(key.count) else { throw KajiWebhookVerificationError("invalid webhook signing secret") }
            keys.append(SymmetricKey(data:key))
        }
        guard !keys.isEmpty else { throw KajiWebhookVerificationError("trusted webhook signing secret required") }
        var signed = Data("\(id).\(stamp).".utf8); signed.append(body)
        var valid = false
        for entry in (metadata["webhook-signature"] ?? "").split(whereSeparator: { $0.isWhitespace }) {
            guard entry.hasPrefix("v1,"), let signature = try? base64(String(entry.dropFirst(3))), signature.count == 32 else { continue }
            for key in keys {
                let match = HMAC<SHA256>.isValidAuthenticationCode(signature, authenticating:signed, using:key)
                valid = match || valid
            }
        }
        guard valid else { throw KajiWebhookVerificationError("webhook signature does not match a trusted key") }
        return body
    }
    public static func verifyAndDecode<T:Decodable>(_ body:Data, headers:[String:[String]], secrets:[String], as type:T.Type, now:TimeInterval = Date().timeIntervalSince1970, tolerance:TimeInterval = 300, decoder:JSONDecoder = JSONDecoder()) throws -> T {
        let verified = try verify(body,headers:headers,secrets:secrets,now:now,tolerance:tolerance)
        do { return try decoder.decode(type,from:verified) }
        catch { throw KajiWebhookVerificationError("verified webhook payload does not match destination type") }
    }
}
